entries.summary: Quantizations below 4-bit are reported broken on this model, not merely degraded. The architecture is the reason: several tensor dimensions are not divisible by 128, so parts of the model cannot be quantized to lower bit widths at all — which is also why Q6_K (33.43GB) and Q8_0 (33.51GB) come out almost the same size.

mitigations.note: Use Q4_K_M or better. The 3-bit build saves 5.7GB and costs far more than that in quality.

entries.summary: LiveCodeBench 68.3 looks strong; SWE-Bench with OpenHands is 38.8. The gap between competition-style problems and real repository work is wide here, and the second number is the one that predicts whether it can fix your bug.

mitigations.note: Pick it for long documents and reasoning, not for agentic coding. Ornith-1.5 35B-A3B and Qwen3.6 27B are the coding models at this footprint.

entries.summary: Released under the NVIDIA Nemotron Open Model License rather than Apache-2.0 or MIT. The weights are downloadable and commercial use is permitted, but it is a vendor licence with its own terms — read them before shipping something on top of it.

mitigations.note: Not a defect. If a permissive licence is a hard requirement, Qwen3.6 35B-A3B (Apache-2.0) and Ornith-1.5 35B-A3B (MIT) are the comparable alternatives.
